events.name: Bash
events.head: Find Day 1 hours wording and probe files
events.input: $ git grep -n "4 to 6 h\|4–6 h\|4-6 h" -- app/src workshop-plan/build cloud/src workshop-plan/playbook.html | head; sed -n 1,40p app/src/lib/day-titles.ts | head -40; ls app/scripts | grep -i probe-details; git log --oneline -1 origin/main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate 4 to 6 h in sources
events.input: $ git grep -n -o ".\{60\}4 to 6 h.\{30\}" -- app/src workshop-plan/build cloud/src workshop-plan/playbook.html ':!app/src/generated' | head; git grep -c "4 to 6 h" -- app/src/generated | head; ls app/scripts | grep -i "probe-details\|check-guides\|probe-head\|probe-onb\|probe-anon"; git log --oneline -1 origin/main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show day header time fields
events.input: $ grep -n -o "Time[^<]*" workshop-plan/playbook.html; grep -n -o 'id="d[0-9]"' workshop-plan/playbook.html; sed -n 3245,3252p workshop-plan/playbook.html | cut -c1-400

events.name: Bash
events.head: Grep other wordings of 4 to 6 hours
events.input: $ git grep -n -E "4 ?(to|–|-) ?6 ?(h\b|hours|hrs)" -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/build workshop-plan/playbook.html ':!app/src/generated' | cut -c1-220 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Search Day header hours source
events.input: $ git grep -n -i -E "\b4[^0-9a-z]{1,5}6\b" -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/build ':!app/src/generated' | grep -i -E "h|hour" | cut -c1-200 | head; grep -n -i "hours\|estimate" app/src/lib/curriculum.ts | head -20; git show b880b67 --stat | head -30

events.text: Still hunting the Day 1 header's "4 to 6 h" source; it isn't in the obvious files.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Search playbook parts for 4 to 6
events.input: $ grep -rn -o -E ".{80}4 to 6.{40}" app/public/playbook-parts app/public/materials workshop-plan/playbook.html workshop-plan/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v "4 to 6 h</span" | head; sed -n 1473,1500p workshop-plan/playbook.html | grep -o -E "[0-9]+ to [0-9]+ ?h[a-z]*|about [^<]{0,40}" | head
